audio.t: Have you paid the electricity fee for our dorm room yet?

questions.explain: 問宿舍電費是否已繳，C 表示昨晚已儲值電卡，最合理。A 重複 room 卻答非所問；B 用 pay 字面混淆（pay attention）。
options: The room is a little too bright at night.
I'll pay attention to the schedule in class.
Yes, I topped up the meter card last night.

audio.t: Why is the laundry room on the third floor closed today?

questions.explain: 問洗衣間為何關閉，A 說明洗衣機正在維修，回答了原因。B 重複 laundry 但沒回答；C 用 close（靠近）與 closed（關閉）的音近混淆。
options: Two of the washing machines are being repaired.
I usually do my laundry on weekends.
It's close to the elevator.

audio.t: Would you mind turning your music down a little? I have an exam tomorrow morning.

questions.explain: 對方請求把音樂關小聲，B 道歉並改用耳機，是合理回應。A 重複 exam、C 重複 mind 與 morning，都答非所問。
options: The exam room is on the fourth floor.
Sorry, I'll use my headphones instead.
I don't mind the morning class.

audio.t: Hi, the air conditioner in room four oh six has been leaking water since last night.
Sorry about that. Did you fill out the online repair form?
I tried, but the dorm website keeps logging me out.
Okay, I'll submit it for you right now. A technician should come by tomorrow afternoon.

questions.explain: 男子說 I'll submit it for you right now，即替她送出報修單。修冷氣的是明天來的技師；網站問題與換房都沒有提到要處理。
options: Fix the air conditioner himself
Submit a repair request for the woman
Help her reset her website password
Move her to another room
questions.prompt: What will the man probably do next?

audio.t: I heard you're thinking of moving out of the dorm next semester.
Yeah. My roommate and I have totally different schedules. She goes to bed at ten, and I usually study until two.
Have you asked the housing office about a room swap? It's much cheaper than renting an apartment.
Not yet. I'll stop by on Friday.

questions.explain: 女子說她和室友作息完全不同（十點睡 vs. 讀到兩點），故選 D。說「便宜」的是男子在比較租屋；距離與獨居都沒提到。
options: The dorm is too expensive
Her room is too far from campus
She wants to live alone
She and her roommate keep different hours
questions.prompt: Why does the woman want to move?

audio.t: Attention, residents of Building C. A fire safety drill will take place this Thursday at nine p.m. When the alarm sounds, please leave by the nearest staircase. Do not use the elevators. Floor leaders will check attendance in the parking lot behind the building. Residents who are absent without a good reason may lose points on their dorm record.

questions.explain: 廣播說樓長會在大樓後方停車場點名，故選 C。樓梯只是離開的路線，不是集合地點；大廳未被提及。
options: In the main lobby
At the nearest staircase
In the parking lot behind the building
questions.prompt: Where should residents gather during the drill?

audio.t: Good evening, everyone, and thanks for coming to our mid-semester floor meeting. I'm Grace, your resident advisor. First, a reminder about quiet hours. From eleven p.m. to seven a.m., please keep noise to a minimum. We've had several complaints about loud video calls in the hallway, so if you need to talk late at night, please use the study lounge on the ground floor.

Second, room inspections will be held on November seventeenth. We'll be checking for things like electric cookers and extension cords without safety switches. These aren't allowed because they're a fire risk. You don't need to be in your room during the inspection, but please make sure your desk and floor are clear.

Finally, the housing office is collecting opinions on a plan to keep the dorm gym open twenty-four hours a day. The survey link is in our floor group chat, and it closes this Sunday. If enough people respond, the change could start as early as next semester.

questions.explain: 舍監依序提醒安靜時段、房間檢查與健身房問卷三件事，屬於多項宿舍事務更新。這是期中會議而非迎新；問卷仍在進行，尚無結果。
options: To update residents on several dorm matters
To welcome new residents to the dorm
To explain how to apply for a room change
To announce the results of a survey
questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the talk?

questions.explain: 原文 please use the study lounge on the ground floor。走廊正是被抱怨的地點；耳機與十一點前通話都沒提到。
options: Make them before eleven p.m.
Keep their voices low in the hallway
Use headphones in their rooms
Go to the study lounge on the ground floor
questions.prompt: What does the speaker suggest residents do if they need to make calls late at night?

questions.explain: B：無安全開關的延長線因有火災風險而禁止；D：問卷本週日截止。A 錯，不需在房內；C 錯，24 小時開放只是提案；E 錯，檢查在 11 月 17 日，下學期指的是健身房可能的改變。
options: Residents must be present during room inspections.
Extension cords without safety switches are not allowed.
The gym is already open twenty-four hours a day.
The survey closes this Sunday.
Room inspections will begin next semester.
questions.prompt: According to the speaker, which TWO statements are true? Choose TWO.

questions.explain: submit an application 是「提交申請」的固定搭配。admit 承認／准入、permit 允許、commit 承諾，都不能接 application 表示繳交。
options: admit
permit
submit
commit
questions.prompt: Students who wish to stay in the dorm over winter break must ______ an application to the housing office by December first.

questions.explain: 一開始就訂好明確規範，目的是「減少」室友衝突，reduce 最合適。refuse 拒絕、reflect 反映、remind 提醒，語意不通。
options: reduce
refuse
reflect
remind
questions.prompt: The new dorm rules are intended to ______ conflicts between roommates by setting clear expectations from the start.

head: From: Housing Office
To: All Dormitory Residents
Subject: Changes to package pickup starting November 4
passage: Because of the growing number of online orders, the front desk is no longer able to store packages for residents. Starting Wednesday, November 4, all deliveries will be sent to the new smart lockers next to the convenience store in Building A.

When your package arrives, you will receive a text message with a six-digit pickup code. Packages must be collected within 72 hours. Items that remain after this period will be moved to the housing office, where they can be claimed on weekdays between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. with a valid student ID.

Please note that the lockers cannot hold refrigerated items or packages larger than 60 centimeters on any side. These will still be delivered to the front desk. We appreciate your patience during this transition.

questions.explain: 第一段指出網購包裹太多，櫃台已無法再保管，故選 B。工作時間、遺失包裹與便利商店需求都未提及。
options: The front desk staff are changing their working hours
The front desk can no longer store all the packages
Students complained about lost packages
The convenience store asked for more space
questions.prompt: Why is the housing office making this change?

questions.explain: 第二段：超過 72 小時未領的包裹會移至宿舍辦公室，故選 C。退回寄件人、多放一天、重發取件碼都沒有出現。
options: It is returned to the sender
It stays in the locker for another day
It is moved to the housing office
The resident receives a new pickup code
questions.prompt: What happens if a package is not picked up within 72 hours?

questions.explain: 此處 claimed 指憑學生證「領取」包裹，與 collected 同義。claim 雖也有「聲稱」之意，但 announced、argued、examined 都不符文意。
options: announced
argued
examined
collected
questions.prompt: The word "claimed" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to

passage: This semester, the university's housing office launched a pilot program that places first-year students with roommates from different departments. In the past, students were usually matched with classmates from the same major, which made it easy to share notes and textbooks. However, a survey last spring found that many students felt their social circles were too small by the end of their first year.

Under the new system, about two hundred freshmen in Building D were randomly matched with roommates from other colleges. An engineering student, for example, might share a room with someone studying literature or nursing. Before moving in, each student completed a short questionnaire about sleeping habits, cleanliness, and study routines, so that roommates would at least have similar daily schedules.

Early feedback has been mostly positive. "At first I was worried we'd have nothing to talk about," said Lin Yu-ting, a business major whose roommate studies physics. "But now we explain our homework to each other, and I've learned more about science than I ever expected." Some students, however, say the arrangement has drawbacks. Several told reporters that it is harder to form study groups when no one on their floor takes the same courses.

Housing director Dr. Chen Ming-hui said the office will review the results in January before deciding whether to expand the program to all dormitories. "We're not trying to replace academic communities," she explained. "We simply want students to meet people they would never meet in class." Students who wish to change roommates can still apply through the usual room-swap process.

questions.explain: 全文介紹讓新生與不同科系同學同寢的試辦計畫，故選 C。睡眠習慣只是問卷內容之一；D 棟並非新建；讀書會反而是計畫的缺點。
options: A survey about students' sleeping habits
The opening of a new dormitory building
A new way of matching roommates in the dorms
A study group program for freshmen
questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?

questions.explain: 第二段：問卷是為了讓室友至少有相近的作息（so that roommates would at least have similar daily schedules）。其餘選項文中未提，且同科系配對正是舊制。
options: To choose which building they wanted to live in
To make sure roommates had similar daily routines
To report problems with previous roommates
To request a roommate from their own major
questions.prompt: Why did students fill out a questionnaire before moving in?

questions.explain: 第三段指出同樓層沒人修相同課程，較難組讀書會。費用未提；最後一段說仍可申請換寢；清潔只是問卷項目，非爭執。
options: It is harder to form study groups.
Rooms in Building D cost more.
Students are not allowed to change roommates.
Roommates often argue about cleanliness.
questions.prompt: What drawback of the program does the article mention?

questions.explain: A：林同學的室友讀物理；E：宿舍辦公室將於一月檢討成果。B 錯，只有 D 棟約兩百名新生；C 錯，仍可申請換寢；D 錯，起因是去年春天的學生問卷。
options: Lin Yu-ting's roommate is a physics student.
The program currently includes every first-year student.
Students in the program cannot use the room-swap process.
The idea came from a request by engineering professors.
The housing office will review the results in January.
questions.prompt: Which TWO statements are true according to the article? Choose TWO.
